reconcile.note: Adam Clarke reconciles the two years by treating Ahaziah's eleventh-year notice as his coregency with his ailing father and the twelfth-year notice as his sole reign.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells catalogues this as a contradiction, but the project's public-domain source survey found no verbatim critic passage that engages it.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells, The Skeptic's Annotated Bible, "When did Ahaziah begin to reign?" (skepticsannotatedbible.com/contra/ahaziah.html) (2013).

sides.snippet: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.
sides.verseText: In the twelfth year of Joram the son of Ahab king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Jehoram king of Judah begin to reign.

sides.snippet: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
sides.verseText: In the eleventh year of Joram the son of Ahab began Ahaziah to reign over Judah.
